koth_release.body:
KOTH 0.5.0 improves LFQ grouping and adds an optional long-format bundle for downstream joint searches.

- Groups now obey bounded mass, retention-time, and ion-mobility spans. Final size/seed filters run after membership is resolved, and each run's primary member is chosen by its own feature quality.
- Long export preserves original feature observations separately from recomputed LFQ cells, including direct/MBR origin, extraction confidence, and source/configuration hashes. Enable it with `[output] export_long = true` in the alignment configuration.
- Independent grouping tolerances, an optional fixed alignment reference, and optional retention of replicated weak-seed groups are documented in `docs/CONFIGURATION.md` and `docs/long-matrix.md`. Experimental retention stays disabled by default.
- Per-run feature-finding defaults are unchanged. Extraction decoys have no original-feature links, and q values are missing when target-decoy estimation is disabled.

Validation passed on Linux, macOS, and Windows, including strict lint/docs checks, unit and doctests, no-default builds, package verification, four real Bruker DDA/DIA integration tests, all nine tuned manuscript configuration parsers, and a native Thermo RAW smoke test using .NET 8.

Absolute QDA extraction-q calibration remains unvalidated; this release makes no new absolute cell-FDR claim. GitHub archives contain the default-feature binaries; native Thermo support requires a source build with `--features thermo` and .NET 8. Each archive includes both `koth_ff` and `koth_align`, with SHA-256 checksums supplied separately.

independent_validation: Decimal rankings, exact integer FDP comparisons, and accession-set checks passed for every cohort/arm/seed at 1%, 3%, and 5%
